query: I'm in the middle of implementing and hit an ambiguous requirement: go ask the product owner directly
reason: The query describes an ambiguous requirement surfacing during implementation and asking the agent to go clarify it with the requirement owner — this is exactly requirement alignment for an active workloom task, which the workloom-alignment description covers ('Use whenever an active workloom planning task needs requirements aligned ... confirming alignment'). grilling is for standalone/non-workloom pressure-testing, tdd and workloom-update-spec are unrelated, so workloom-alignment is the correct choice and matches the ground truth.
